reports.text: Water from Alau Dam has breached river banks into Gwange and Maiduguri central. Streets under 1.5m of water, families trapped on roofs.
Urgent: Custom Bridge and Lagos Street in Maiduguri overtopped by rapid flash floodwaters following Alau Dam overflow. Evacuation boats needed.
Heavy flooding across Maiduguri metropolitan area since 4am. Over 500 displaced households gathering at high ground near post office.
Confirmed dam breach impact in Maiduguri. Clean water sources contaminated, immediate shelter and WASH kits required for displaced families.
Shehu's Palace area and Monday Market surrounded by deep flood water. People need rescue and dry rations immediately.
